results.title: "The problem is not in the EVM machines, nor in the voter lists": BJP leader Sudhanshu Trivedi on NDA victory in Karnataka MLC elections
results.description: New Delhi [India], October 28 (ANI): Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Sudhanshu Trivedi on Wednesday launched a scathing attack on the Congress party and its leader Rahul Gandhi over their allegations regarding the electoral process, claiming that the results of the Legislative Council elections showed the party had failed to win public support even in elections conducted using ballot papers and ballot boxes.
